page.layout: One printed page, single column of dictionary entries; running head at top centre; page number top left; a catchword "Aranea]" at lower right below the last line. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Canalis structilis, Vitr. Rivus, Vlp. Cuniculus rivi ad piscinam perducatur, Col.
Aqualis,scil. Vrceus] Guttus, Liv. Gutturnium, Fest. Trulleum, Non. Urceus manalis, Sipont.
Aquaria mola] Hydraula, Vitruv. Hydromyla, Iun. Molinæ, Amm.
Aquari pecudes] Dare potatum bubus, Col. Salivare ægrum pecus medicamine, Id.
Aquarium, (1) ubi jumenta aquantur] Aquatio, Col. Pabula & aquationes pecudum mutare. Canalis aquationi destinatus, Id.
(2) Latrina, quâ sordes effluunt] Lavatrina. Urinarium, Var. Labrum. Eluacrum, Cato. Aquariolum,Iun. Fusoria coquinæ procul sint apibus, Pallad.
Aquarius] Aquator, Cæs. Utrarius, Liv. Astronomis Amphora.
Aquaticus] Aquatilis mus, Plin. Aquatilis bestia, Cic.
Aquatile] Æquoreum genus. Natantum genus, Virg. Natatilia, Rob. Steph. Iun.

Aqueus,aquæ similis] Undatus, Plin. Undatim crispus,Id. Aquosa crystallus, Propert. Vitreus, Horat. Vitro æmulus fluvius, Apul. Hyalus color. Hyali fucatus colore. Plumbeus color. Thyles, Glaucinus, Mart. Galbineus, Veget. Color cæruleus dilutior, Id.
Aquila] Regalis avis, Apul. Jovis ales,Virg. Avis magna, Plaut. Aquila, Vultur,Turneb. Avis præpes, Virg. Præpes, Val. Argon. Rex alitum.
Aquilex] Indagator aquarum, Col. Librator, Plin. Aquarius, Front. Præfectus castello aquæ. Castellarius, Meurs. ex Veter. inscript.
Aquilus color] Luridus, Hor. Pullus, Vitruv. Fuscus. Infuscatus, Col. Impluviatus, Plaut. Hispanum. Thyles. Suasum, Plaut.
Aquosus] Aquosa nubes, Virg. Undosum æquor, P. Virg. Aquaticus Auster, Ovid. Aquatus, Plin.
Ara] Altare, Cic. Altare, Diis superis. Ara, Diis inferis, Fest.

page.notes: Several entry headwords are in a script-like italic capital and some are partly illegible; "Aquarius" and "Aquosus" headwords were read with some uncertainty. The "Aranea]" at the foot is a catchword.
